Part-time master's or PhD study
Views:
If you are a domestic student, you can study for a master's or PhD part-time. You will need to provide the reasons why you need to study part-time when applying for admission.
If you are an international student, check with the Student Visa Services team at the International office (email: student.visa@otago.ac.nz) to determine if you are able to study part-time. Typically, a student visa does not permit part-time study.
Student Visa Services
You should also consider the impact on any scholarship that you hold before you decide to proceed with part-time master's or PhD study.
Keywords: parttime, part, master's, PhD
